say:2:1241103001:1.text: Water magic... hmm, that's odd. I remember there being a note about it in this book...
say:2:1241103001:1.source_cn: 和水有关的魔法……唔，好奇怪，我明明记得这本笔记上有记...

choice_prompt:3:1241103001.text: Water magic... hmm, that's odd. I remember there being a note about it in this book...
choice_prompt:3:1241103001.source_cn: 和水有关的魔法……唔，好奇怪，我明明记得这本笔记上有记录的呀……

say:4:1241103002:1.text: Yes, I want to find some spells useful for the sea to avoid the same trouble as before.
say:4:1241103002:1.source_cn: 嗯，我想找一些在海边能派上用场的魔法，免得再出现之前那种事。
say:4:1241103002:1.male: Yes, I want to find some spells useful for the sea to avoid the same trouble as before.
say:4:1241103002:1.female: Yes, I want to find some spells useful for the sea to avoid the same trouble as before.

say:5:1241103003:1.text:
What happened before?
...Oh, you mean when the other little hamster fell in the sea...
say:5:1241103003:1.source_cn: 之前那种事？\n……啊，你说的是另外那只小仓鼠坠海的事。

say:6:1241103004:1.text: That's right, being in Rustport means we have to go out to sea often. Chippy refuses to take off his bulky little armor, so I'm trying to solve this problem with magic.
say:6:1241103004:1.source_cn: 是啊，我们身处锈锚港，少不了要乘船出海，满满又不愿意脱...

choice_prompt:7:1241103004.text: That's right, being in Rustport means we have to go out to sea often. Chippy refuses to take off his bulky little armor, so I'm trying to solve this problem with magic.
choice_prompt:7:1241103004.source_cn: 是啊，我们身处锈锚港，少不了要乘船出海，满满又不愿意脱下那套沉重的骑士盔甲，我只能从魔法上想想办法了。

say:8:1241103005:1.text: Well, I did consider asking for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but I worry about constantly relying on you...
say:8:1241103005:1.male: Well, I did consider asking for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but I worry about constantly relying on you...
say:8:1241103005:1.female: Well, I did consider asking for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but I worry about constantly relying on you...

say:9:1241103006:1.text: Besides, you need your rest! I don't want to trouble you with something so small.
say:9:1241103006:1.source_cn: 更何况你也需要休息！我不想用这样一件小事麻烦你。
say:9:1241103006:1.male: Besides, you need your rest! I don't want to trouble you with something so small.
say:9:1241103006:1.female: Besides, you need your rest! I don't want to trouble you with something so small.

say:10:1241103007:1.text: I've got a plan—I'll make a waterproof amulet that Chippy can wear!
say:10:1241103007:1.source_cn: 我已经想好怎么做了——用防水魔法制作护符，让满满戴在身...

say:11:1241103008:1.text: Hey, just a thought—since you're already using magic, why not be more direct about it?
say:11:1241103008:1.source_cn: 嘿，不是我说，你们既然都用上魔法了，干嘛不更直接一点？

say:12:1241103009:1.text: Like, you could just make him fly! Then he could go anywhere he wanted!
say:12:1241103009:1.source_cn: 比如，直接让人飞起来！想去哪就去哪！

say:13:1241103010:1.text: That said, is there any spell that could transform people into birds? Swifts, seagulls, anything like that?
say:13:1241103010:1.source_cn: 这么说来，有没有能让人变成鸟的魔法，给我用用？雨燕，贼...

say:14:1241103011:1.text: I've wanted to leave Rustport and go exploring for so long—after all, sea monsters might own the ocean, but they can't snatch birds from the sky!
say:14:1241103011:1.source_cn: 我早就想离开锈锚港去外面看看——那个海怪，总不能连天上...

choice:7:0:1.text: You can ask for my help!
choice:7:0:1.male: You can ask for my help!
choice:7:0:1.female: You can ask for my help!
